title: Kanden Kadhalai
desc: Sakthivel and Anjali are poles apart, but circumstances bring them together. However, the pair soon part ways as Anjali elopes to meet her true lover.

title: Rambo
desc: Two men raised with opposing beliefs clash when hidden secrets of past are revealed. One is a ruthless heir to an empire and the other is a kind-hearted orphan but both must face the brutal conflict.

title: Vallavanukku Pullum Aayudham
desc: Sakthi befriends Vaanathi while travelling to his village to sell his ancestor's property. Little does he know that her father has been waiting for him to seek revenge for more than two decades.

title: Ayalaan
desc: Four friends stumble upon a lost alien and help him get back to his home planet. Together, they face an evil scientist whose plan is to create a bioweapon that could destroy life on Earth.
